name: Alternating Optimization Strategy
definition: A strategy to mitigate optimization instability caused by the highly coupled influence of base geometric attributes (rotation and scaling) and skewness parameters on the primitive's spatial footprint. It partitions shape-related parameters into two disjoint groups and optimizes them alternately.
summary: Alternating Optimization Strategy stabilizes gradient descent by partitioning coupled shape parameters into disjoint groups and optimizing them alternately, preventing degenerate primitive shapes.
